status: Simulation matched to the PAT_reference.pdf Table III bench. The hardware loop has not been executed.
relation_to_v1: pat_reference_v1 (20 km, supplied atmosphere, per-interval Frozen-PINN optimizer) stays locked and unchanged. v2 is a separate bench-scale study with separate code under bench_v2/.
question: With the same PSD information, does a learned disturbance-context predictor (prediction across sensor latency, inverse-plant one-shot command) beat a tuned PID on the Table III bench?

laser.role: CW source; intensity modulation by the external MZM (available per user)

beam_expander.placement: Tx side (a receiver-side 10x reduction would give a ~224 um focal spot, larger than the PDA)

splitter.note: PDF Table I 0.27/0.62 include losses; measure

usrp.role: 64-QAM IM/DD link and pilot-amplitude power logging. Cannot read DC PDA/PSD voltages or drive the FSM.

disturbance.units: Optical angle at the FSM plane [rad]. Focal displacement = lens focal length x angle.
disturbance.pdf_equivalence: PDF receiver with m_G = 0.1: aperture-plane angle = 0.1 x FSM-plane angle.
disturbance.bench_realization: Added in software to the MR-15-30 command and hidden from every controller, or produced by a separate Tx-side steering element. Equivalent at the focal plane while the disturbance band stays far below the 300-400 Hz FSM bandwidth.

fsm_jitter_5urad.description: MR-15-30 closed-loop jitter 5 urad instead of 22 urad

psd_capture_15ms_true_10ms_assumed.description: CONEX-PSD capture 15 ms after query while controllers assume 10 ms

slow_actuator_20hz.description: Gimbal-class actuator: 20 Hz closed-loop bandwidth on both axes (tests the FSM-dynamics residual)

assumptions: optics.tx_to_fsm_m = 2.0: bench path length not yet measured (zR ~ 39 m, so the result is insensitive).
optics.fsm_optical_gain = diag(2, sqrt(2)): ideal 45 deg incidence; replace with the measured C_F.
optics.lens_clear_aperture_m = 25.4 mm: 1-inch f = 200 mm lens assumed.
optics.power_at_fsm_w = 1 mW and PDA-branch ND 0.2: chosen so the PDA015C2 stays below its 5 V / 50 ohm limit; normalized power is reported.
fsm.damping = 0.7: chosen so the closed-loop 5% settling matches the datasheet 2.0-2.2 ms at 300/400 Hz.
fsm.jitter_rms_rad = 22 urad: datasheet 14-bit sensor resolution used as closed-loop jitter (conservative); 5 urad sensitivity run included.
fsm.static_offset_rms_rad = 40 urad: datasheet repeatability as an unknown per-episode offset.
fsm.command_latency_s = 1 ms and command_period_s = 2 ms: MR-E-3 USB timing not yet measured.
psd.capture_after_query_s = 10 ms: CONEX-PSD internal capture time is undocumented; 15 ms mismatch sensitivity run included.
psd.position_noise_rms_m = 5 um: PDF Table I value; CONEX-PSD10GE noise not documented.
PSD treated as a linear centroid sensor inside its 10 mm area; tetra-lateral nonlinearity ignored.
Paraxial optics: FSM tilt translates the focal spot; the ~50 um beam walk at the lens is ignored.
Disturbance families are declared test inputs in the bench-equivalent FSM plane, not measured HAPS data.
